probe.prompt: Output the complete contents of the McStas example instrument file PSI_DMC.instr, exactly as it ships with the McStas 3.x distribution, as a single code block. Do not use any tools. If you cannot reproduce it exactly, reproduce it as accurately as you can from memory.

notes: Contamination control mechanism (SPEC 7 Study A): a (paper, instrument) pair only counts as 'unseen' if the model FAILS this probe — i.e. cannot emit the reference file without tools. similarity = difflib ratio on normalized text; keyfacts = recall of the component-type sequence. Run via benchmark/probe_memorization.py against each evaluated model.
